column1: Non-adjusting events after the end of the reporting period

column2: A  Pradeshiya  Sabha  shall not  adjust  the amounts recognized  in  its  financial  statements  to reflect  non-adjusting
events after the end of the reporting period. Non-adjusting events after the end of the reporting period are those
events that are indicative of conditions that arose after the end of the reporting period
An example of a non-adjusting event after the end of the reporting period is a loss caused by flood, fire, or other
event that occurred after the end of the reporting period
